lines.text: Elisha refuses to leave Elijah as they travel from Gilgal to Bethel, Jericho, and the Jordan.
Elijah strikes the Jordan with his rolled-up cloak, and the waters part so they cross on dry ground.
Elisha asks for a double portion of Elijah's spirit, then sees Elijah go up in a whirlwind.
Fifty men search for Elijah for seven days but do not find him.
Elisha casts oil into the spring, and the LORD heals the water.
